title: Two Sum
description: Given an integer array nums and an integer target, return the zero-based indices of two different elements whose sum equals target. Exactly one valid pair exists.
outputFormat: Print the two zero-based indices in increasing order.

title: Maximum Subarray
description: Find the maximum possible sum of a non-empty contiguous subarray.

title: Product of Array Except Self
description: Return an array where answer[i] is the product of every input element except nums[i]. Do not use division.
constraints: Each result fits in a signed 64-bit integer

examples.explanation: Each position excludes its own element.

title: 3Sum
description: Return all unique triplets whose values sum to zero. Each triplet must be sorted, and the complete result must be lexicographically sorted.
outputFormat: First print the number of triplets. Then print one sorted triplet per line.

examples.explanation: There are two unique zero-sum triplets.

title: Container With Most Water
description: Given vertical line heights, choose two lines that hold the maximum amount of water. Return that maximum area.

examples.explanation: Lines at indices 1 and 8 produce area 49.

title: Find the Duplicate Number
description: An array of n+1 integers contains values between 1 and n. Exactly one value appears more than once. Find that duplicate without modifying the array.

title: Trapping Rain Water
description: Given non-negative bar heights of width one, calculate how many units of rainwater are trapped after raining.

examples.explanation: The elevation map traps six units.

title: First Missing Positive
description: Find the smallest positive integer that does not appear in the unsorted array. Aim for linear time and constant extra space.
outputFormat: Print the smallest missing positive integer.

examples.explanation: Values 1 and 2 exist, but 3 does not.
The smallest absent positive value is 2.

title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
description: Given two sorted arrays, return the median of their combined elements. The expected solution should run in logarithmic time relative to the smaller array.
inputFormat: First line: integers n and m
outputFormat: Print the median with exactly five digits after the decimal point.

title: Sliding Window Maximum
description: For every contiguous window of size k, return the maximum value in that window.
inputFormat: First line: integers n and k
outputFormat: Print the window maximums separated by spaces.

examples.explanation: Each value is the maximum of one length-three window.
